EU and Indonesia Sign Landmark Trade Deal

The European Union and Indonesia have signed a comprehensive and ambitious trade agreement. The deal covers a range of sectors, including palm oil and pharmaceuticals. This agreement is described as a landmark development in their economic relationship.
